verses.1: In parts according to verses. A Psalm of David. For the octave.
verses.2: O Lord, do not rebuke me in your fury, nor chastise me in your anger.
verses.3: Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am weak. Heal me, Lord, for my bones have become disturbed,
verses.4: and my soul has been very troubled. But as for you, Lord, when?
verses.5: Turn to me, Lord, and rescue my soul. Save me because of your mercy.
verses.6: For there is no one in death who would be mindful of you. And who will confess to you in Hell?
verses.7: I have labored in my groaning. Every night, with my tears, I will wash my bed and drench my blanket.
verses.8: My eye has been troubled by rage. I have grown old among all my enemies.
verses.9: Scatter before me, all you who work iniquity, for the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.10: The Lord has heard my supplication. The Lord has accepted my prayer.
verses.11: Let all my enemies be ashamed and together be greatly troubled. May they be converted and become ashamed very quickly. [ Psalm 7 ]
